exposure: pelvic floor muscle training (PFMT) with home biofeedback therapy (HBT)
cohort: The study included 36 women with sexual dysfunction during their reproductive period, with an average age of approximately 34-35 years.
finding: Pelvic floor muscle training with home biofeedback therapy significantly improved sexual dysfunction, pelvic floor muscle strength, and quality of life in women compared to a control group.
